speaker: David
text: I have brought provisions from Bethlehem for my brothers.

speaker: Baggage keeper
text: Leave them here, young shepherd. I will keep them safe.

speaker: David
text: Thank you. Where can I find my brothers?

speaker: Baggage keeper
text: By the line beyond the tents. Follow the path, and stay clear of the ranks.

speaker: Eliab
text: David? Who is tending the sheep at home?

speaker: David
text: They are in safe hands. Our father sent food, and asked me to see how you are.

speaker: Eliab
text: We are well. Stay close. The camp is waiting for the champion's next challenge.
